definitions.explanation: Used to ask about the price or cost of something.
In the pattern いくら〜ても, means 'no matter how much.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{幾|いく}ら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much does it come to in total?

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾|いく}ら⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the train ticket?

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{来|き}ませんでした→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かりません→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I talk, they don't understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{幾|いく}ら⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: How much is each one? I'll take three, please.

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{思|おも}いつきません→思い付く：02027_omoitsuku⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I think, I can't come up with a good idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾|いく}ら⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{高|たか}そう→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: How much did this watch cost? It looks expensive.

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれませんでした→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I called, they didn't come.

notes:
{幾|いく}ら is one of the most essential question words for daily life in Japan.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾|いく}ら⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: How much is this? (basic shopping phrase)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{幾|いく}ら: How much in total?
- {幾|いく}ら〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how much (concessive pattern)

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana (いくら) rather than kanji ({幾|いく}ら). The kanji ⟦{幾|いく}→幾〜：00444_iku⟧ is relatively uncommon in everyday use.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いくつ→幾つ：00944_ikutsu⟧: how many (for countable items or age)
- ⟦どのくらい→どのくらい：09584_donokurai⟧: how much/how long (for degree or extent)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with ⟦イクラ→イクラ：10715_ikura⟧ (salmon roe), which is a loanword from Russian.
